Week of June 14

Filed under: #weekly | Sat Jun 20 2026

Hi. Another week, another week in review.

Goals I set for this week last week:

  • continue work on website;
  • continue work on UTAU;
  • I'd like to watch that Backrooms movie with my mom ~not a goal~;
  • continue drawing and posting;
  • write a Week in Review (on Sunday)

I did work on my website a little and I did work on my UTAU a little, but most of my week was spent drawing, seriously. I put in 15 hours on Procreate last week, and nothing else of note really happened. So I don't have much to write about… sorry. But I'm going to the beach this week, and Deltarune Chapter 5 drops this week too, so I'll have a lot to say when I write the next Week in Review! (Or perhaps I'll be too busy playing the new chapter.)

Also, I listened to a few (two or three) songs on my "Songs to listen to" list, but that wasn't one of my goals or anything.

Music streaming has really started to piss me off, so I decided I would nuke my Spotify account (not before I get all my data though). I've had the account since 2018, so that's a lot of stuff that's going to become semi-lost media, but that's fine by me. I also deleted my last.fm account a while back. Seeing music stats is cool, but it's not even remotely accurate since I also listen to tons of music on YouTube, Niconico Douga/the Vocacolle app, .mp3, etc.

My goals this week are to have fun, continue drawing, and do as I like. See you all next week.
